title: Ubaghara language
description: Cross River language spoken in Nigeria
extract: Ubaghara is an Upper Cross River language spoken by the Ubaghara people, an Efik subgroup in Biase local government area of Cross River State. The Ubaghara language is a mixed of Efik and Qua (Ejagham). However most speakers still speak the Efik language interchangeably.
